lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na6In2S8 (reduced formula Na3InS4) is orthorhombic with space group Pmn2_1 (No. 38) and 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows In centers in octahedral S6 environments, while Na centers adopt both 4-coordinate S4 and 3-coordinate S3 environments. S centers display 3- and 4-coordinate geometric coordination, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.43 to 2.89 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between In octahedra and Na 4-vertex polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between In octahedra.
